introHtml: Iridescent pens catch light and attention with their shifting, rainbow-like finish. Unlike standard solid-color pens, these shimmering writing instruments stand out on desks and in giveaways, making them a smart choice for trade shows, product launches, or any campaign where you want your logo to sparkle. The color-shifting surface pairs well with pad printing or laser engraving for a clean, professional look. Order custom iridescent pens in bulk to add a memorable, eye-catching touch to your next promotion.
